settings.audioAdvanced.crossfade.title: Track Transition Crossfade
settings.audioAdvanced.crossfade.subtitl: Defines transition overlap effect; prebuffer gate is configured in Preprocess.
settings.audioAdvanced.enginePolicy.help: Purpose: quickly apply tested policy combinations. Note: presets overwrite current engine policy fields; audition and apply after switching.

Purpose: choose transport strategy. Robust favors compatibility/stability; Transport Exact favors bit-level consistency. Note: Transport Exact constrains parts of the chain to avoid unintended alteration.

Purpose: choose when SRC is applied. Source Native keeps original rate, Match Output follows device rate, Target Rate forces a fixed rate. Note: forced SRC increases CPU cost. Tip: on shared output backends (WASAPI shared / Rodio), Target Rate is disabled and playback follows the device mix rate to avoid unsupported formats.
Purpose: select SRC backend. Rubato favors quality; Linear SIMD favors performance. Note: on lower-end devices, Linear SIMD is usually more stable.
Purpose: set target sample rate in Target Rate mode. Note: higher rates consume more resources and may fall back when unsupported by the device.
Purpose: define float-to-integer output quantization. Round is cheaper; TPDF reduces low-level quantization distortion. Note: this is constrained to Round in Transport Exact mode.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.title: Dynamic SRC
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.a: Purpose: automatically switch to a safer SRC policy based on runtime conditions. Note: policy may change dynamically, so disable during strict A/B listening.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.p: Purpose: quickly choose Dynamic SRC hold/timing profiles. Responsive favors agility; Extreme Stability keeps conservative windows longer under stress.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.l: Purpose: learn from recent runtime behavior to improve switching decisions. Note: learned behavior is environment-dependent and can be biased by short-term anomalies.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.r: Purpose: delay restoring high-quality policy after load recovers. Note: too small causes oscillation; too large stays conservative for longer.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.m: Purpose: enforce minimum interval between policy switches. Note: too small can flap; too large reduces responsiveness.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.s: Purpose: keep a stable policy for a short period after seek. Note: increase for complex tracks to reduce post-seek pops.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.u: Purpose: keep protection policy active after underrun. Note: too short can re-underrun; too long sacrifices quality policy longer than needed.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.s: Purpose: keep protection policy during shared-path stress windows. Note: increase in heavy multitasking scenarios.
settings.audioAdvanced.dynamicSrc.help.o: Purpose: hold protection policy during output error recovery windows. Note: increase on unstable drivers to reduce repeated retries/stutter.

settings.audioBuffer.title: Audio Preprocess
settings.audioBuffer.desc: Playback data preparation policy: predecode controls production, prebuffer controls delivery (not crossfade effect duration).
settings.audioBuffer.subtitle: Predecode strategy + prebuffer gate (predecode = production, prebuffer = gate)
settings.audioBuffer.note.thresholdNotCa: These prebuffer thresholds are minimum wait targets for startup/seek/before-crossfade, not a hard buffered-ahead cap.
settings.audioBuffer.note.metricsLocatio: Metrics panel: Debug -> Native Debug -> Audio Robustness.
settings.audioBuffer.startOrSeek.label: Start/Seek prebuffer
settings.audioBuffer.startOrSeek.desc: Target buffered audio before starting playback or after seeking (0 disables the wait).
settings.audioBuffer.crossfade.label: Prebuffer Gate Before Crossfade
settings.audioBuffer.crossfade.desc: Minimum buffered audio required before entering track-transition crossfade (effective when crossfade is enabled in Advanced).
settings.audioBuffer.decodeMode.label: Decode mode
settings.audioBuffer.decodeMode.desc: Controls decode strategy: Streaming = decode while playing with a bounded window; Full-track (background) = start after prebuffer gate, then decode as much of the track as possible in the background.
settings.audioBuffer.decodeMode.range: This is a mode switch (no numeric min/max): Streaming = windowed predecode; Full-track (background) = aggressively expands predecoded coverage.
settings.audioBuffer.decodeMode.warning: Full-track (background) can noticeably increase burst CPU/IO and memory usage; very long files are constrained by buffer budget limits.
settings.audioBuffer.section.decode.desc: Defines how the decoder prepares PCM data (on-demand streaming or whole-track predecode).
settings.audioBuffer.section.prebuffer.d: Defines minimum playable data before start/seek and before crossfade; this is a gate, not overlap duration.
settings.audioBuffer.startOrSeek.policyR: Runtime policy target window: 0-4 s (may be raised temporarily during recovery/stress).
settings.audioBuffer.crossfade.policyRan: Runtime policy target window: 0-3 s (may be raised temporarily during recovery/stress).
settings.audioBuffer.note.estimate: Estimated decoded audio in memory (at {sampleRate}Hz, {channels}ch): Start/Seek ~{startMiB} MiB, Before crossfade ~{crossfadeMiB} MiB.
settings.audioComponents.title: Audio Output/Input
settings.audioComponents.desc: Choose output backend/device and input decoder (foobar-like).
settings.audioComponents.note.requireNat: Requires running in Tauri desktop runtime (Native Audio).
settings.audioComponents.outputBackend.d: Switch output implementation (e.g. rodio-cpal). Changing backend resets selected output device.
settings.audioComponents.outputBackend.o: Best compatibility (default). Usually shared device path; not bit-perfect guaranteed.
Through system mixer, usually stable but may resample (non bit-perfect).
Requests RAW path in shared mode with larger buffer for better stress tolerance; still depends on device/driver support.
Initialization may fail if RAW is unsupported by device/driver; switch while stopped is recommended.
Exclusive device path, best-effort bit-perfect/no-resample (opens by source sample rate/channels).
Exclusive mode may fail when device doesn't support target format/sample rate; switch while stopped is recommended.
Low-latency output (requires ASIO driver; only available in ASIO-enabled builds).
ASIO capability is constrained by Steinberg ASIO SDK licensing; if abnormal/silent, switch back to WASAPI (shared/exclusive) for verification.
Current build doesn't enable ASIO (asio-sdk). Switch to ASIO build and restart to use it.

settings.audioComponents.audioInput.note: Full-track decode mode loads the whole track into memory before playback; best for stability, but uses more memory and slower open on long files.
